entries.name: guard-git-add-all
entries.deploy_when: an indiscriminate git staging command (git add -A / . / --all)
entries.too_much_if: the user explicitly asked to stage everything this once
entries.mechanism: indiscriminate staging sweeps in secrets and junk; explicit paths are safer
entries.key: git add with -A / . / --all rather than named paths
entries.artifact: deny — stage explicit paths instead, e.g. `git add file1 file2`

entries.name: entity-to-go-struct
entries.deploy_when: generate a Go struct type from an entity spec with named fields
entries.too_much_if: the entity needs methods or embedding the template can't express
entries.mechanism: the deterministic template renders the struct exactly; json tags when a field carries one
entries.key: entity + fields -> a Go `type X struct` declaration
entries.artifact: render `type <Name> struct { <Field> <Type> [json tag] ... }` via the template

entries.name: categorize-bash-command
entries.deploy_when: classify a shell command into a category (git/build/search/...)
entries.too_much_if: the command is a novel class the rule table has never seen
entries.mechanism: a deterministic rule table covers the common classes; the residual goes to a model
entries.key: a single shell command needing a category label
entries.artifact: apply the rule table per &&/;-segment; first real action beats a leading cd

entries.name: verify-quote-against-source
entries.deploy_when: check that a quoted passage actually appears in its cited source
entries.too_much_if: the claim is a paraphrase, not a verbatim quote (no exact match to gate on)
entries.mechanism: fetch the source, byte-match the quote — the operational gate for source-backed facts
entries.key: a verbatim quote with a citable source to confirm
entries.artifact: fetch source; normalize whitespace; assert the quote is a substring; else FLAG
